bio.text: Lou Correa was elected to the U.S. House of Representatives in 2016 and represents California's 46th Congressional District.
He served in the California State Assembly (elected 1998), on the Orange County Board of Supervisors, and in the California State Senate.
He grew up in Anaheim, graduated from California State University, Fullerton, and earned a J.D. and MBA from UCLA; he worked as a banker, attorney and licensed real estate broker.
